tracks.title: today is my favorite
tracks.excerpt: An album-length EP by the 20-year-old producer is a dizzying and boundless collage of collages, using free-jazz logic and digital overload to chart new emotional terrain.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这位20岁的制片人制作了一张专辑长度的EP ，这是一张令人眼花缭乱的无限拼贴画，使用自由爵士逻辑和数字过载来绘制新的情感地形。

tracks.excerpt: Dis Fig What To Make Of These Mortal Hands Her debut was called PURGE and it was about her. This one is about what people do to each other, and it is named after the part of the body that does it What To Make Of These Mortal Hands by Dis Fig The title tells you where to look. Hands make things and hands wreck them, and Felicia Chen has built her second solo album around that double function. Track
tracks.excerpt_zh: Dis Fig What To Make Of These Mortal Hands她的首次亮相被称为清洗，它是关于她的。这个是关于人们对彼此做什么的，它以身体的一部分命名，它如何制作这些凡人的手由迪斯无花果标题告诉你在哪里看。手工制作东西，手工破坏它们， Felicia Chen围绕这种双重功能制作了她的第二张个人专辑。曲目

tracks.title: Spin
tracks.excerpt: Johnny Marr The Age of Everything Former Smiths guitarist settles some scores – with himself, and others When I spoke to Johnny Marr for Huck in 2019, all Morrissey talk was off the table. tracks.excerpt_zh: 约翰尼·马尔（ Johnny Marr ）《万物时代》（ The Age of Everything ）前史密斯吉他手与自己和其他人达成了一些协议。当我在2019年与哈克（ Huck ）的约翰尼·马尔（ Johnny Marr ）交谈时，所有莫里西（ Morrissey ）的不过， Marr是一位非常和蔼可亲的受访者，鉴于谈话进展顺利，我忍不住滑入了一个厚颜无耻的问题，即一个未透露姓名的“某人”是如何蚕食遗产的

tracks.title: Chords
tracks.netease_artist: Jason Dungan, Johan Carøe, Blue Lake
tracks.excerpt: Copenhagen-based composers Jason Dungan (Blue Lake) and Johan Carøe join forces on Routine , a quietly transportive collection of ambient folk and new age soundscapes shaped through an exchange of musical fragments. Blending acoustic instrumentation, electronics, and Dungan’s self-designed 36-string zither, the duo arrive at something intimate and unhurried—a luminous meditation on domestic ritual
tracks.excerpt_zh: 哥本哈根作曲家杰森·邓根（ Jason Dungan ） （蓝湖）和约翰·卡罗（ Johan Carøe ）联合创作了《例行公事》（ Routine ） ，这是一本通过音乐片段交换而形成的静悄悄地运输环境民谣和新时代音景的集合。两人融合了声学仪器、电子设备和Dungan自行设计的36弦琴弦，得到了一些亲密而又不着急的东西--对家庭仪式的发光冥想

tracks.title: Psychic Video
tracks.excerpt: The UK selector throws caution—and genre—to the winds on an audacious 82-minute set that careens between ambient, drill’n’bass, post-punk, breakcore, and more.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 英国选择器在一个大胆的82分钟集合中对风投以谨慎和流派，该集合在环境， drill 'n 'bass ， post-punk ， breakcore等之间进行调整。

tracks.title: Goodbye to All That
tracks.excerpt: Torn between Texas and Topanga but fully herself, the songwriter sounds at home in the outlaw country idiom on an intimate, searching new record produced by Shooter Jennings.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这位词曲作者在德克萨斯州和托潘加之间徘徊，但完全是她自己，在家里用不法之徒的国家成语听起来很亲密，搜索射击者詹宁斯制作的新唱片。

tracks.title: Inside Voice
tracks.excerpt: Like the best giallo scores, Surprise Chef's Frogs In A Pond finds beauty in the uneasy marriage of the sinister and the seductive. Its analog warmth and locked-in grooves evoke a bygone era without becoming trapped in it, blurring the line between recordings from 2026 and 1976. tracks.excerpt_zh: 像最好的giallo得分一样，惊喜厨师的池塘中的青蛙在险恶和诱人的不安婚姻中找到了美丽。它的模拟温暖和锁定的凹槽唤起了一个过去的时代，而不会被困在里面，模糊了2026年和1976年的录音之间的界限。作品令人毛骨悚然的情绪与8首曲目的录音相结合，创造了一个听觉的暮光之城，

tracks.title: A MAN A CURE
tracks.excerpt: Cork trio Ana Palindrome make a hypnotic blend of art-pop, droning vocals, sawing fiddle, and glitchy folktronica on “A MAN A CURE,” their first release for London’s World of Echo. Beneath its pulsing rhythms and woozy electronics, the track questions the idea of self-made identity, as Niamh Dalton’s voice shifts between the organic and the artificial. The post Ana Palindrome :: A MAN A CURE first
tracks.excerpt_zh: 软木三人组Ana Palindrome在“A MAN A CURE”上融合了流行艺术、嗡嗡声、锯子小提琴和毛骨悚然的民谣，这是他们在伦敦回声世界的首次发行。随着Niamh Dalton的声音在有机音乐和人工音乐之间转换，在它的脉动节奏和昏昏欲睡的电子音乐下，赛道对自制身份的概念提出了质疑。文章Ana Palindrome:: A MAN A CURE first

tracks.title: School's Out!
tracks.excerpt: The irreverent duo of Leo Fincham and Rowan Please plies its brilliantly digitized indie-pop bricolage on an album with the ragtag splendor of a low-budget musical.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 不敬的Leo Fincham和Rowan Please二人组合将其精彩的数字化独立流行拼凑在一张专辑中，并伴随着低成本音乐剧的破烂辉煌。

To close out the year, the group has dipped into its archives, re-releasing the 1996 EP Hi Scores . tracks.title: This is How it Should Be Done
tracks.excerpt: For their collaborative full-length debut, Eris Drew and Octo Octa hunkered down in their New Hampshire cabin to craft a celebratory, sample-heavy tribute to the maximalist dance music of yore.
tracks.excerpt_zh: Eris Drew和Octo Octa在他们的新罕布什尔州小木屋里蹲下，为他们合作的全长首演制作了一个庆祝性的样品，向昔日的极致舞曲致敬。
